label: Graded foundation: AGWF and J2 from a rigid well-founded grade of being that support ascends
summary: Question (#310, #1485, modal-spine Next investigations item 2): do well-founded actual grounding (AGWF, whose only prior derivation ran through the uncalibrated numeric potential bundle via finite rank) and J2 (whose only prior derivation used no-novel-edge) rest on one deeper commitment shared with the direct routes' grade maximum? Sense check: STMT-ACTUAL-GROUND-IS-MORE-IN-ESSE and STMT-NO-INFINITE-ASCENT-IN-BEING bind the same primitive MoreIn esse parameter and the same DEF-MORE-IN/DEF-ESSE records (DISAMB-BEING-UNIVOCITY, DISAMB-ORDER-OF-BEING: one primitive comparative); no sense bridge needed. The ascent statement over-linked two WELL_FOUNDEDNESS_AND_ANTI_BRUTE_ROOT senses (ActualRoot, GroundAncestor) its type does not reach; those two links were removed (rule of attempt a062ed2b). Verified (GradedSupportFoundation batch, zero axioms, Comparator and NanoDa): (1) actualGroundingWFOfAscent: AGWF from the ascent premise and no infinite ascent among actual concreta (weak sibling of the global premise; actualAscentWFOfGlobal registers the strength order). A second, non-numeric route. (2) unionWFOfAscent: J2 from rigid ascent of support between necessary concreta at every admitted world and no infinite ascent among necessary concreta; no reflexivity, AGWF or no-novel-edge. mutualSupportExcludedByGrade excludes the mutual-support rival from the same two premises. (3) groundMoreInEsseOfCause: the ascent premise from the unrestricted Aristotelian cause-is-more principle (d5a94eb1, itself derived from the reception-limitation bundle 924302df) and an open ground-to-esse-cause bridge; everywhereAscentOfCause gives every-world ascent from the same principle and an every-world bridge; every-world ascent implies both ascent premises (strength orders). (4) Characterizations gradedOfActualGroundingWF and gradedOfUnionWF: each well-foundedness condition yields SOME rigid well-founded grade it ascends; with (1)-(2) the graded forms are equivalent to AGWF and J2 when the grade is freely chosen. So the graded route is not a weaker commitment; its content is the identification of the grade with the Fourth Way's MoreIn esse, whose global no-infinite-ascent premise also gives STMT-GRADES-TO-MAXIMUM-AT-BEING. Answer: AGWF, J2 and the grade maximum share one commitment, global no infinite ascent in esse, plus ascent premises (unified by every-world ascent), but that commitment is not smaller than AGWF itself. Controls: joint witness (all premises with nonempty edge, grade and cause); DescendingGrade (well-founded grounding and grade without ascent: ascent is substantive); OffWorldAscent (every-world ascent and no infinite ascent hold while coverage and no-novel-edge fail, so the grade does not yield coverage and is not comparable with no-novel-edge); NoGradeForRivals (rotating triangle and rooted pair admit no comparison at all satisfying rigid ascent and restricted no-infinite-ascent; the rooted pair still has the join's endpoint). Failed or not attempted: coverage from a rigid grade fails (OffWorldAscent); asymmetry and whole-roster nontrapping need no new theorem (AGWF already yields asymmetry by 16539528, which feeds the roster routes); a formal control for dense convergent grades (ascent without well-foundedness, e.g. grades 1-1/n) is prose only.
blocker: All new premises are open analyst premises: the ground-to-esse-cause bridges (selected-world and every-world), rigid ascent, and both restrictions of no infinite ascent. The bridge is plausible only if the selected relation is principal sustaining of being, not instrumental or compositional dependence (DescendingGrade is the formal shape of the failure). Next tests: formal control for dense convergent grades; whether DEF-PRESENT-ESSE-SUPPORT's orientation examples (fuel and flame) are principal causes of being; an independent argument for no infinite ascent among actual concreta that does not reduce to the #310 actuality argument.
